# XEngine patches to Paper (UI framework)

Baseline for diffing: Anthology tag `v2.8.6` (commit `b3ab895d`), path `Paper/` — see `UPSTREAM.txt`.
Retrieve any baseline file with `git show v2.8.6:Paper/<path>`.

## Status

- Was vendored at **v2.8.6**; **synced to v3.3.0 on 2026-08-31** (M1.5, atomic with M1.6 Quill —
  upstream Paper v3.3.0 calls new Quill Canvas APIs, so the two libs must compile together).
- Upstream v2.8.6→v3.3.0 lib changes were small (+2/−2 DevTools, +5/−2 ElementBuilder,
  +80/−2 Input, +53/−14 Interaction); the rest of upstream churn was Samples (not synced — see below).

## Local patches (large local performance/reliability workstream — preserved through the sync)

- **Layout engine zero-allocation pass**: `LayoutEngine/LayoutScratchPool.cs` (new),
  `LayoutEngine/ListSpanCompat.cs` (new), heavy local rework in `ElementData.cs` (+~165),
  `ElementLayout.cs` (+~125), `StretchItem.cs`, `ChildElementInfo.cs`.
- **`ElementBuilder.cs`** (+~420 local): builder API extensions consumed by the editor.
- **Stateful event handlers**: `Events/StatefulHandlers.cs` (new) — `SfFocusChange` and friends;
  `Paper.Input.cs`/`Paper.Interaction.cs` fire them alongside upstream events.
- **Style typed writes**: `Paper.StyleValues.cs`/`Paper.Styles.cs` local rework.
- Local tests: `ChildIndexPoolTests`, `FollowUpFrameTests`, `RenderCommandPoolTests`,
  `StatefulHandlerTests`, `StyleTypedWriteTests` (all XEngine-only).

## Sync resolution notes (2026-08-31)

- `ElementBuilder.cs` / `Paper.Input.cs`: 3-way clean.
- `Paper.Interaction.cs`: 4 conflicts, all the same pattern — local `SfFocusChange` invocations
  vs upstream cosmetic reformat; resolved **keeping local side** (superset: fires both handlers).
- `DevTools/PaperDevTools.cs`: taken from upstream (needs Quill `VertexCount`/`IndexCount`,
  provided by the Quill sync).
- **Samples not synced**: upstream's new sample shaders are generated by Quill's ShaderGen
  (not vendored here) and the deleted `Samples/Common/CanvasShaderSource.cs` is kept — samples
  are not consumed by the engine build.
- Deferred upstream feature: Canvas per-vertex brush-gradient (`brushInverse`) — collides with
  the XEngine brush-record GPU contract (`UI.shader` UiBrushes); see Quill PATCHES.md.

## Verification (2026-08-31 sync)

- `Paper.Tests`: **22/22 pass**. Full `XEngine.sln`: **0 errors**.
